# IJRASET

> IJRASET is a peer-reviewed, open-access international journal publishing research in applied science and engineering technology with fast-track publication and low-cost access.

IJRASET (International Journal for Research in Applied Science and Engineering Technology) is an UGC-approved, impact-factor indexed research publication platform recognized by major indexing services including Thomson Reuters, Crossref DOI, Google Scholar, and Index Coppernicus. The journal serves researchers and academics seeking affordable, rapid dissemination of engineering and applied science research.
